Short title extent and commencement

THE PRISONS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1926
THE PRISONS
(PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1926
[Received the
assent of the Governor on 22nd July, 1926; that of the
Governor-General on 9th August, 1926; and was first published in the
Punjab Government Gazette of the 16th august, 1926.]
(Punjab Act IX of
1926)
[16th August, 1926]
An Act to amend the Prisons Act, 1894
1. Short title extent and
commencement. (1) This Act may be called the Prisons (Punjab Amend ment)
Act, 1926.
(2) It extends to the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force on
such date as the [Subs., for Local Government , by A.O., 1937.][Provincial
Government] may by notification appoint in this behalf.

Amendment of section 6 of the Prisons Act  1894

THE PRISONS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1926
THE PRISONS
(PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1926
[Received the
assent of the Governor on 22nd July, 1926; that of the
Governor-General on 9th August, 1926; and was first published in the
Punjab Government Gazette of the 16th august, 1926.]
(Punjab Act IX of
1926)
[16th August, 1926]
An Act to amend the Prisons Act, 1894
2. Amendment of section 6 of
the Prisons Act, 1894. To section 6 of the Prisons Act, 1894, the following
further proviso shall be deemed to be added, namely :-
"Provided
further that in the Punjab the [Subs., for Local Government , by A.O., 1937.][Pro vincial
Government] may appoint for any prison, a Deputy Superintendent instead of a
Jailor, and an Assistant Superintendent instead of a Deputy or Assis tant
Jailor, and these officers when so appointed shall exercise the same power,
shall discharge the same duties, and shall be subject to the same disabilities
as Jailors and Deputy or Assistant Jailors respectively."
